chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyHint: Write a message or attach a file.
chat.providerNotice: Messages and attachments are processed by OpenAI.
chat.aiCaution: AI can make mistakes. Check important information.

generation.timingHint: Time to first text includes the wait for OpenAI and any reasoning before the answer.

errors.invalid: Check the message, filename or conversation name.
errors.failed: Could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.limit: This conversation reached its message or attachment limit. Start a new chat.
errors.tooLarge: Each attachment can be up to 2 MiB.
errors.attachmentCount: You can attach up to 3 files per message.
errors.unsupportedFile: Attach a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, Markdown, JSON, JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
errors.notConfigured: Ask an administrator to configure the model and activate a system prompt.
errors.providerUnavailable: Could not reach OpenAI. Try again.
errors.providerRejected: OpenAI rejected the request. If this persists, ask an administrator to check the API key and model.
errors.providerLimit: OpenAI rate limit or API quota reached. Try again later or ask an administrator to check your API quota.
errors.incomplete: The reply was interrupted or incomplete. Try again.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Try again.
errors.busy: A reply is already being generated for your account.
